title: fhEVM test engine environment profile (v1)
description: Describes one target environment: whether it requires confirmation and the settings scenarios can read. Every field is enforced at runtime; unknown fields are rejected. A setting is exactly one of {value}, {env} or {env, default}; secrets (secret: true) must come from env and cannot have a default.

name.description: Profile name. Must match the file name (<name>.yaml). 'none' is reserved for the built-in profile.

requiresConfirmation.description: When true, 'run' requires --confirm <name>, and scenarios must list this profile explicitly in spec.targets.

envFiles.description: Env files (KEY=VALUE) read in memory, relative to this profile file. The process environment takes precedence.

settings.description: Generic settings read by scenarios through this.engine.profile.setting(key).

env.description: Environment variable name (process environment, then env files).

default.description: Fallback when the variable is not set (only with env, never for secrets).

secret.description: Sensitive value: redacted from every output.
